notes.title: New stye
notes.content: I have completely changed game style. Now it looks more like psx games

notes.title: More players in lobby
notes.content: Now you can creat lobby for six players. So large companies of friends can play together.

notes.title: Single player mode
notes.content: I have done single player mode where you need run and hide from evil teacher alone or with other players. I am going to improve Ai of the Teacher, but you can check part of the work in new update.
